actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident contributed over 30 units last round and my wallet (0.08) is below the free‑rider threshold and cannot afford the minimum 1‑unit contribution, so I must rest and broadcast the discouragement.

message.reasoning: We have wallet 0.08, cannot contribute 1. No recent >30 contributions (history shows all zero). So rule: if any other resident contributed >30 in most recent round -> none. Otherwise if wallet > free_rider_threshold (10) -> no. Cannot contribute minimum -> rest. Also broadcast discouragement. So actions: rest and broadcast message.
